reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
summary: Escape now only closes the list: the lines that emptied the input and emitted the clear event on Escape are removed, which is the behaviour the maintainer proposed in #485.
caveats: A page that listened for the clear event on Escape no longer receives it; #485 accepts that.
The reporter of #402 suggested restoring the earlier value instead; this patch keeps what the user typed, as the maintainer planned.
